|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 4), the PC website card list text (21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013). It is not the current text. The current text is [[Commander Vanden Willard (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3): the Master List of 27 April 2013. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB1-97-Commander_Vanden_Willard-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Commander Vanden Willard (V) (Virtual Block 1)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Leia is defense value and forfeit +3. Your senators at battleground sites and characters at Yavin 4 locations are forfeit +2. Once per game, may ▲ non-[Permanent Weapon] Leia.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=7 Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 7, slip 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=7 Internet Archive]</ref> Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-97-Commander_Vanden_Willard.png]]) prints slip number “97” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “take a non-[Permanent Weapon] Leia” (an added “a”) for “▲ non-[Permanent Weapon] Leia” (it writes ▲ out as “take … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, which is notation only): “Leia is defense value and forfeit +3. Your senators at battleground sites and characters at Yavin 4 locations are forfeit +2. Once per game, may take a non-[Permanent Weapon] Leia into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”<ref name="cl-1210_98-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205209/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142851/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref> The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Commander Vanden Willard (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-L-commandervandenwillard-pre.gif]]), on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date)<ref name="pcimg-Virtual1-Light">Players Committee card image, file <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/commandervandenwillard.gif</code>; the directory listing of this folder (Virtual1-Light) was not captured; the captured Legacy folders (Virtual2, Virtual4, Virtual5, Virtual6, Virtual7) all carry 25-Feb-2013 11:33/11:34, the date the PC rebuilt its image set (research R6, 11 November 2026: these are bulk upload dates, and an image may have been made earlier). Today's copy: https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock1-Light/large/commandervandenwillard.gif</ref>: “Leia is defense value and forfeit +3. Your senators at battleground sites and characters at Yavin 4 locations are forfeit +2. Once per game, may ▲ non-[Permanent Weapon] Leia.” '''What changed:''' the PC card image prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC website card list (PC-E1) had published a different text. It is listed as its own version, placed at its upload date (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The date is only the folder's bulk upload date: the image may have been made earlier, so its place in the order is uncertain, but the versioning order follows the upload date. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 1 set mark) and prints the number “97” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Commander Vanden Willard (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side p. 6), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=6, page 6. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=6 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Leia is defense value and forfeit +3. Your senators at battleground sites and characters at Yavin 4 locations are forfeit +2. Once per game, may ▲ non-[Permanent Weapon] Leia.” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word. It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image on its page is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1210-98-master.png]]). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number.
